scripts.dev: bun run db:start && concurrently -n "platform,client,model" -c "blue,green,yellow" "bun run dev:platform" "bun run dev:client" "bun run dev:model"
scripts.dev:model: bash -c 'cd apps/model-service && source .venv/bin/activate && ENV_FILE=$([ -f .env.local ] && echo .env.local || echo .env) && PORT=$(grep -E "^PORT" $ENV_FILE | tr -d " " | cut -d= -f2) && uvicorn app.main:app --env-file $ENV_FILE --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port ${PORT:-8000}'
scripts.start: bun run build && bun run db:start && concurrently -n "platform,client,model" -c "blue,green,yellow" "bun run start:platform" "bun run start:client" "bun run start:model"
scripts.db:env: bash -c '[ -f packages/database/.env.local ] && echo packages/database/.env.local || echo packages/database/.env'
scripts.db:start: bash -c 'docker compose --env-file $(bun run --silent db:env) -f packages/database/docker-compose.yml up -d db'
scripts.db:stop: bash -c 'docker compose --env-file $(bun run --silent db:env) -f packages/database/docker-compose.yml stop db'
scripts.db:clear: docker exec portfolio-rebalancing-db psql -U ${POSTGRES_USER:-postgres} -d ${POSTGRES_DB:-portfolio_rebalancing} -c "TRUNCATE usermodelhistory, globalmodelhistory RESTART IDENTITY; TRUNCATE users RESTART IDENTITY CASCADE;"
scripts.db:clear:weights: docker exec portfolio-rebalancing-db psql -U ${POSTGRES_USER:-postgres} -d ${POSTGRES_DB:-portfolio_rebalancing} -c "TRUNCATE usermodelhistory, globalmodelhistory RESTART IDENTITY;"
scripts.db:reset: bash -c 'docker compose --env-file $(bun run --silent db:env) -f packages/database/docker-compose.yml down -v' && bun run db:start && bun run --filter database db:push
